prompts: Use case: background-extraction. Extract the EXACT watercolor meadow and white walking cat illustration at the very bottom of this approved Leximory screen into a production UI asset. Preserve the reference illustration's exact composition, soft botanical watercolor texture, grasses, tiny white flowers, pale yellow-green light, irregular painted edges and the white cat walking right in the left third. Output ONLY the meadow illustration as a wide horizontal strip, approximately 3.0:1 aspect ratio, transparent around the natural irregular upper and lower watercolor edges. Crop away all interface, text, buttons, white page, rounded corners and every letter. No redesign, no new objects, no shadow, no rectangular background. Keep the original illustrated cat within the meadow. The goal is visual fidelity to this approved artwork, not a new interpretation.

Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Extract the pale sage watercolor marker brushstroke BEHIND the word 'bank' at the upper part of this approved Leximory screen. Remove the black word bank and all Chinese/English text entirely, inpainting ONLY the same pale translucent green watercolor texture beneath. Output ONLY one clean wide irregular watercolor highlight swipe, transparent background, about 4:1 width to height. Match its exact delicate yellow-green/sage color, watery pigment pooling, torn brush edge and subtle uneven paper wash. No letters, no symbols, no meadow or cat, no interface, no opaque white rectangle, no gradients or hard rounded geometric edges. It will stretch behind live editable type.

Use case: lighting-weather. Create a dedicated DARK APPEARANCE sister asset for Leximory's approved watercolor meadow. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its exact wide 3:1 composition, irregular watercolor silhouette, fine botanical brushwork, tiny flowers, and white walking cat in the left third. Image 2 is a COLOR/LIGHTING REFERENCE ONLY: use its calm moonlit blue/teal/forest-green tones and delicate firefly points. Repaint the meadow convincingly at night with deep muted blue-green foliage, restrained cool silver highlights on blades and daisies, and softly moonlit ivory-gray white cat. Keep watercolor paper texture and hand-painted details, do not convert to realistic digital landscape. The entire strip must look beautiful against iOS near-black #000000 or #1c1c1e, with no pale white/yellow halo around the outer alpha edges. Actual transparent background, no opaque black rectangle, no sky or added background, no type, no controls. Do not invert colors or merely darken the light artwork: this is deliberately moonlit night painting with the same composition.

Use case: lighting-weather / precise-object-edit. Make the dedicated DARK MODE version of this exact watercolor marker swipe. Preserve its wide 4:1 shape, natural irregular brush edges, layered translucent pigment and paper-grain texture. Repaint using a deep, muted forest-jade/sage pigment, with subtle moss-green pooling and cool green-blue undertones. It will sit on iOS #000000/#1c1c1e behind warm white italic EB Garamond type, so provide enough green presence to read as a deliberate marker stroke while keeping white text clearly legible. No pale cream, yellow, white outer halo, opaque background, letters, shadows, interface or symbols. Actual transparent background. Do not use color inversion: create a harmonious night-specific painted asset.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Repaint ONLY the watercolor marker stroke in image 1 to harmonize exactly with the moonlit meadow in image 2. Preserve image 1's exact shape, thin layered watercolor texture, irregular alpha edges and wide aspect ratio. Replace all warm forest/olive/jade green with the SAME cool desaturated SLATE BLUE and blue-teal pigment used in image 2. Target dominant #294858, subtle lighter washed #496A7B, and deeper pooling #173141. It should look like paint mixed for the meadow, not a separate green brand accent. Intended background is iOS dark #1c1c1e and warm white live italic type appears above it, so keep the pigment restrained and dark enough for clear white text. Output ONLY the repainted single marker swipe with actual transparency. No meadow, cat, text, black rectangle, glow, white or green fringe, or additional objects. This is a palette correction to match the existing dark meadow, not a redesign.
